text:
It is because a little mountain bird has made,

in the hollow of a tree, its morning nest,

that the tree dawns with music in its breast,

as if it had a musical heart.


If the sweet little bird peeps through the hollow,

to drink dew, to drink aroma,

the tree of the hills gives me the feeling

that its heart has come out, singing.

translation.title: The Nest
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the tree's nest as an exposed singing heart.
